title: Fresh-session affine correction resolution around DSW-09 root
method: For each Href, compute exact q_ref and exact tangent, form API HCOF/RHS, start a new MODFLOW6 6.8.0 one-cell prepared solve with Sy=0 and record convergence and affine root.
required_controls: fresh-session 1e-6 and 1e-8 offsets must solve and reproduce the exact affine root
smaller offsets and observed-stall replay are diagnostic and are not retuned if MODFLOW declines convergence
purpose: Discriminate per-solve API/IMS resolution from history-dependent reanchoring behavior.
forbidden: do not weaken DSW-09 residual gate
do not treat this post-observation diagnostic as blind validation
